Hi Alex / Sara —

Thanks again for taking time last week to walk through the MAP milestones. Per our plan, this thread will be the weekly checkpoint for Dedicated/Private capacity sizing and alignment before we lock the Q2 commit. Attached is the working MAP workbook (setaudio_map_v3.xlsx) with the current proposed GPU mapping by region.

Key asks for this week:
- Confirm the target peak concurrency and steady-state throughput you expect per region (tokens/sec and concurrent sessions).
- Approve the tentative GPU mix so we can start procurement/reservation discussions: A100-80GB (in us-west), H100-80GB (in us-east), and optional T4 fallback in eu-central for DR.
- Flag any regulatory or network requirements that would force a Private/VPC deployment instead of Dedicated.

What I updated in the workbook:
- Sheet "Capacity Plan": initial counts per region and 95th pctl throughput estimates.
- Sheet "SLOs": latency targets for short and long prompts.
- Sheet "Owners": named Redwood and SetAudio owners for each line item.

Preliminary numbers (please treat as draft):
- US-West: 8x A100-80GB (dedicated), target steady throughput 5k tokens/sec, 250 concurrent sessions
- US-East: 4x H100-80GB (burst + low-latency), target steady throughput 3k tokens/sec, 150 concurrent sessions
- EU-Central (DR): 6x T4.8xlarge (fallback), target throughput 1.2k tokens/sec (warm standby)

Meeting notes and action items are in the attached workbook. Can you reply with confirmations or adjustments by EOD Thursday so we can feed numbers into the cost model?

Thanks —

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear write-up. Quick updates from our side after we ran a short eval against the Alpha model:

Confirmed (subject to final perf tests):
- US-West: prefer 6x A100-80GB to start (we saw diminishing returns after ~6 nodes for our prompt mix). If needed we can burst to 2 additional A100s in peak windows.
- US-East: ok with 4x H100-80GB as proposed for low-latency routing for East Coast users.
- EU-Central: we want a warm standby but reduce to 3x T4 nodes for now to lower cost; we will do DR drills to validate failover.

Throughput: our initial internal perf shows ~4.2k tokens/sec steady across US-West with the 6x A100 config and avg latency 180ms for 512-token prompts. We'll attach the short perf dump by EOD.

Open concerns:
- Network egress architecture: we need to verify Private deployment egress IPs for allowlisting with our CDN partner.
- Encryption-in-transit: our security team prefers Private with customer-managed KMS for production PII workloads.

Action: I'll drop final perf numbers and the perf dump in this thread tomorrow. For now we approve the reduced EU standby and 6x A100 in US-West.

Thanks —
Alex Chen
Head of Platform | SetAudio

Thanks Alex — good clarity. Couple of follow-ups from infra/planning perspective:

1) GPU mix and reservation windows
- US-West: update plan to 6x A100-80GB committed, with policy to allow 2x burst A100s for 2 weekend windows per month. We will size batch queue length to keep tail latency below 500ms.
- US-East: 4x H100-80GB reserved for low-latency; recommend pinning these to a separate priority pool to avoid interference with large-batch workloads.
- EU-Central: move to 3x T4 nodes warm standby; we'll run a failover benchmark during the next DR exercise (owner: Marissa).

2) Throughput SLOs (to be reflected in MAP sheet 2)
- US-West target steady throughput: 4,200 tokens/sec; peak burst target: 7,500 tokens/sec (during scheduled marketing spikes).
- US-East target steady: 3,000 tokens/sec; peak burst 4,500 tokens/sec.
- EU-Central standby: 1,200 tokens/sec (warm).

3) Security/Private request handling
- Alex flagged preference for Private deploy for PII flows. We need the following from SetAudio to give a final recommendation: list of endpoints that will carry PII, expected retention policy, and KMS requirements. Please upload the security questionnaire answers to the Drive link.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Alex / SetAudio: upload perf dump + security questionnaire answers (due 2026-05-07 EOD)
- Marissa (Redwood): schedule DR failover benchmark and capture results (due 2026-05-14)
- Vivek (Redwood): generate cost delta for 6x A100 vs 8x A100 and the reserved vs burst pricing (due 2026-05-11)
- Kimberly: consolidate MAP and submit to procurement for Dedicated capacity reservation (due 2026-05-12)

I've updated the "Owners" tab in setaudio_map_v3.xlsx with these owners and deadlines.
